synthetic.rule: Use the exact complete profile in this package; never inherit it as a historical or actual account fact.

required_before_execution: approved research purpose and exact source manifest
exact as-of and complete same-as-of account baseline
stock, industry and total risk limits
finite comparison budget and stop conditions
historical_proposal.rule: The 500000 initial value and five buckets remain a proposal until all required conditions are explicitly adopted.

daily_simulated_template.rule: Do not replace null fields with zero, an empty collection, synthetic facts or broker-displayed free cash.

actual_account_template.scope: P12 and Owner fact collection only
actual_account_template.rule: Bind an exact broker account and same-as-of facts only after P12 parameter and consumer preparation; never invent an empty account.

same_as_of_values: canonical tradeable cash before internal pending-buy holds
policy_values: target N, finite B and reserve

producer_rule: The accounting adapter must label whether supplied cash already excludes internal holds. The current RiskSnapshot.cash_available boundary is canonical cash before the pending_buys commitment in the same typed snapshot.
